faq.headline: Frequently asked questions

items.question: Can foreign nationals buy property in the UAE?
items.answer: Yes. Foreign nationals can buy freehold property in designated areas across Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Ras Al Khaimah, with full ownership rights and no requirement to be a resident.

items.question: What is off-plan property, and how does payment work?
items.answer: Off-plan means buying before completion, directly from the developer. Payment is staged against construction milestones, and buyer funds are held in a government-regulated escrow account until handover.

items.question: What taxes apply to UAE property investment?
items.answer: There is no capital gains tax and no income tax on rental proceeds. A one-off Dubai Land Department transfer fee of 4% applies at purchase, plus standard registration and agency costs.

items.question: Does buying property qualify me for a Golden Visa?
items.answer: A property investment of AED 2 million or more can qualify you for a 10-year renewable Golden Visa, covering your spouse and dependants. We can walk you through the current requirements.

items.question: How does RealTerra select the projects it recommends?
items.answer: Every project passes a five-point screen: developer track record, completion risk, yield floor, exit liquidity, and a documented growth thesis. If a launch fails any of them, we do not present it.
